name: Executable permission guard
summary: Reject suspicious staged executable-bit additions before they enter repository history.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse gate for git commit that examines bounded staged mode changes and blocks executable permission added to declarative or documentation files, or to text scripts without a recognized shebang.
refuses: It does not chmod, rewrite, stage, unstage, execute, sign, or approve a file.
It does not claim that a recognized shebang makes a program safe or portable.
It does not inspect filesystem permissions that are not represented in the staged Git index.
It does not provide a repository-authored extension or path bypass.

entrypoints.purpose: Inspect staged Git modes and bounded blob prefixes before accepting newly executable repository files.
